name: Beanstalk
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version default)/bin:$PATH"; cd food-recall-app && npm ci

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version default)/bin:$PATH"; cd food-recall-app && npm run dev
terminals.description: Default first-run surface only (see docs/practices/onboarding.md). Vite for food-recall-app at http://localhost:5173/beanstalk/ (append ?demo=1 for fictional demo data). Uses nvm default Node 22.x. Other packages (notification-service, openfda-proxy, android, ios) are installed on demand.
